title: 眼睛怎么看见东西
subtitle: 光跑进来，脑子把它翻过来
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt, dark green shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bold flat graphic art with clean edges and flat fills, warm amber, deep teal and cream, simple and graphic, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
我把一只眼睛闭上，
再把另一只也闭上。
什么都看不见了。
睁开眼睛，
屋子又回来了。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in a room with one hand over one eye, the other eye open, looking ahead, curious.

pages.zh:
眼睛自己不会发光。
是光跑进眼睛里，
我们才看得见。
把灯全关掉，
再大的眼睛也看不见东西。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rooms side by side on a cream background: the left one lit with a lamp and a chair clearly visible, the right one dark with the same chair only faintly outlined. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
光是从瞳孔进去的。
瞳孔就是眼睛中间
那个黑黑的小洞。
光太亮它就缩小，
光太暗它就张大。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two eyes side by side on a cream background: the left one with a small pupil, the right one with a large pupil, everything else identical. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
瞳孔后面有一块
透明的小镜片，
叫晶状体。
它把散开的光
聚到眼睛的后壁上。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one lens shape in the middle of a cream background with three straight rays arriving from the left and bending through it to meet at one point on the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
眼睛的后壁上，
铺着一层薄薄的膜，
叫「视网膜」。
它像一块屏幕，
光落在上面就成了像。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one eyeball shown in cross-section on a cream background with the back wall drawn as a thick curved layer in a different colour. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有意思的是：
落在视网膜上的像，
是倒过来的。
上面的跑到下面，
下面的跑到上面。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one candle on the left of a cream background pointing up, rays crossing through a small lens in the middle, and the same candle on the right pointing down. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
视神经把这些信号
送进大脑。
大脑一看，
就把它重新翻正过来。
所以我们看到的世界是正的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one eyeball on the left of a cream background with a thick line running from its back to a simple brain shape on the right, and one arrow along that line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我们有两只眼睛。
它们离得有一点距离，
看到的画面稍稍不同。
大脑把两张合起来，
就知道哪个近、哪个远。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two eyes side by side at the bottom of a cream background, each with a straight line going up to the same cup, the two lines meeting at a clear angle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
看远处的时候，
晶状体变薄；
看近处的时候，
它变厚。
它一直在悄悄地调。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two lens shapes side by side on a cream background: the left one thin with a distant tree beyond it, the right one thick with a near book beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一直盯着近处，
它就一直用力，
会累。
所以看一会儿书，
要抬头看看远处的树。
pages.scene: A window on a cream background with a green hill and a tree visible far outside, and an open book lying closed on the sill. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
眼睛还会自己保养。
眼泪冲掉灰尘，
眼皮一眨就把它抹匀，
睫毛挡住掉下来的东西。
它一直在照顾自己。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one eye on a cream background with a row of lashes above it and three small drops at its inner corner. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我抬起头，
看向很远的山。
眼睛一下子松开了。
原来它忙了这么久，
我一直都不知道。
pages.scene: The little boy looks up and out through a window at distant green hills, his face relaxed and calm.
